name: golang-project-restructuring
description: Break a large golang project into SOLID domains — use-case slices with handler, service, repository and model layers behind role interfaces — sized so each one can be planned, reviewed and improved on its own: surveys every facet with read-only sub-agents, writes a domain map, carves it with one sub-agent per domain in its own worktree, generates or updates Dockerfiles, proves parity with the original in a side-by-side Docker run, cleans up, documents, and tags the new major — all under a ledger, with hooks that keep a carve resumable and un-shippable until it is done.
